definitions.explanation: Refers to the surface of a table or desk, or something designed for use on a table. Very commonly used as a modifier for compact products meant to sit on a desk or table.
Figuratively refers to something that exists only in discussion or theory, not in practice. Often used in the phrase {卓上|たくじょう}の{空論|くうろん} (armchair theory).

examples.japanese: {卓上|たくじょう}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
{卓上|たくじょう}⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手元|てもと}→手元：07605_temoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I brightened my workspace with a desk lamp.

examples.japanese: {卓上|たくじょう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{加湿器|かしつき}→加湿器：06491_kashitsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らなくて→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: A tabletop-sized humidifier is convenient because it doesn't take up space.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卓上|たくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空論|くうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: That is nothing more than armchair theorizing.

examples.japanese: {卓上|たくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing will change with only theoretical discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{卓上|たくじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no point making plans on paper without knowing the actual situation on the ground.

notes:
A versatile word used both literally and figuratively. In its literal sense, it is extremely common as a product descriptor for compact items designed for desk or table use. In its figurative sense, it implies impracticality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卓上|たくじょう}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: desk calendar
- {卓上|たくじょう}⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧: desk lamp
- {卓上|たくじょう}⟦{加湿器|かしつき}→加湿器：06491_kashitsuki⟧: desktop humidifier
- {卓上|たくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空論|くうろん}: armchair theory; impractical theorizing
- {卓上|たくじょう}⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧: tabletop stove

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {机上|きじょう}: on the desk — nearly synonymous; ⟦{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}→机上の空論：30514_kijounokuuron⟧ is more common than {卓上|たくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空論|くうろん}
- ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on the table — plain spoken equivalent for the literal sense
